about.title: MyCoins Demo
about.description: This application is a centralized financial dashboard designed to manage multiple bank accounts and personal or family expenses. Originally conceived as a complex spreadsheet, it evolved into this PWA to overcome the limitations of maintaining a complex Excel file with multiple dynamic sources and advanced visualizations. Beyond its utility, this project serves as a technical showcase hosted on the cloud to test modern standards and latest framework updates.
about.privacy_text: No data is collected or saved. This application runs entirely on the client side.
